name: web-whats-new-badge-with-outlined-violet-pill-and-release-link
title: Centred announcement: violet outlined pill 'What's new?' followed by grey 'Just released v4.3.1 >' on white
whatItIs: A white page with a single line at the centre: a thin violet-bordered capsule with violet text 'What's new?' and to its right grey text 'Just released v4.3.1' with a small chevron.
whatItMeans: Understated and useful; a tiny announcement line signals activity without demanding attention.
techniques: Outline a coloured pill for the label.
Centre with lots of white space.

vocabulary.definition: A short line announcing a release.
A capsule with a border only.
A label with a release number.
A link ending with a small arrow.
